Saudi Toyota Championship Drift

Drifting

Slide with speed. Control the angle. Master every corner.

Explore Drifting

A Saudi Toyota Championship discipline

Speed.Angle.Control.

Drift is one of the Saudi Toyota Championship’s disciplines. Drivers hold a controlled sideways slide through a designated course and are judged on drifting skill, maneuvering, speed, and control.

  1. 01

    Control the Slide

    Hold a controlled slide while maintaining speed and car control.

  2. 02

    Master the Angle

    Balance steering and throttle to carry the car through each turn.

  3. 03

    Tandem Competition

    Drivers demonstrate their speed and control in one or two tandem runs.
